title: ceropegia hadhramautica
intro: Ceropegia hadhramautica, commonly known as the 'Desert Rose', is a species of flowering plant in the family Apocynaceae. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, which include the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Ceropegia hadhramautica are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
